items.summary: Bloomberg, citing sources: Anthropic PBC is growing at an annualized revenue pace above $65 billion, more than seven times the level at end of last year.
items.summary_zh: 据彭博援引知情人士透露，Anthropic PBC目前正以超过650亿美元的年化营收速度增长，较去年年底的水平增长逾7倍

items.title: What will TV look like in three years? Media insiders share their predictions
items.title_zh: 三年后的电视会是什么样？业内高管分享预测
items.summary: CNBC asked media insiders what they think the TV market — from pay TV subscribers to sports ratings — will look like in three years.
items.summary_zh: CNBC 询问业内高管对三年后电视市场（从付费电视用户到体育收视率）的看法。

items.title: Disney's new parks boss outlines investment strategy, with superfans at the fore
items.title_zh: 迪士尼新乐园负责人勾勒投资战略，超级粉丝优先
items.summary: Disney Experiences chief Thomas Mazloum is focused on balancing the needs of its most ardent parkgoers with its less frequent visitors.
items.summary_zh: 迪士尼体验业务负责人 Thomas Mazloum 专注于平衡最忠实的游客与偶访游客的需求。

items.title: Sanders proposes bill to stop Social Security benefit garnishment for unpaid student loans
items.title_zh: 桑德斯提议立法，禁止因未偿还学生贷款扣押社会保障福利
items.summary: Sen

items.title: UK, Japan and China all trimmed US Treasury holdings in June
items.title_zh: 6月英国、日本和中国持有的美国国债规模均较5月下降
items.summary: US Treasury data shows Japan held $1.117 trillion, down $26.4 billion from May; the UK held $939.9 billion, down $8.7 billion; China held $633.4 billion, down $26 billion.
items.summary_zh: 美国财政部数据显示，其中，日本持有美债1.117万亿美元，较5月减少264亿美元；英国持有9399亿美元，环比减少87亿美元；中国持有6334亿美元，环比减少260亿美元

items.title: OpenAI executive departures raise concerns; president plays them down: it's normal, we're just too closely watched
items.title_zh: OpenAI高管接连离职引担忧，总裁“灭火”：其实很正常，只是我们太受关注
items.summary: OpenAI co-founder and president Greg Brockman said Monday that the recent spate of executive departures is not unusual, business momentum remains strong, and the company is actively addressing a cybersecurity incident involving one of its AI models.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI联合创始人兼总裁Greg Brockman周一表示，近期公司高管接连离职并不罕见，公司业务增长势头依然强劲，并正积极应对一起涉及旗下AI模型的网络安全事件

items.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.31%, the highest in 19 years
items.title_zh: 30年期美债收益率突破5.31%，创19年新高
items.summary: Treasury yields were higher as traders awaited the latest FOMC minutes due later this week.
items.summary_zh: 美债收益率走高，交易员等待本周晚些时候发布的最新FOMC会议纪要。

items.title: Goldman says AI productivity gains are not here yet. But these stocks will benefit most when they begin
items.title_zh: 高盛：AI生产率红利尚未到来，但一旦开启这些股票受益最大
items.summary: The investment bank compared companies' labor intensity and artificial intelligence sensitivity to see where AI implementation gains will make an impact.
items.summary_zh: 该投行比较了各公司的劳动密集度与AI敏感度，以判断AI落地收益将在何处显现。

items.title: This small-cap ETF just hit a fresh high and its members have lots of cash. Wall Street likes these stocks
items.title_zh: 这只小盘股ETF刚创出新高，成分股现金充裕，华尔街看好这些股票
items.summary: Some small-cap stocks offer a potent combination of dividends and healthy free cash flows
items.summary_zh: 部分小盘股兼具丰厚的股息与健康的自由现金流。
